component.name: ASUS Control
component.summary: G-Helper style control panel for ASUS laptops, built on top of asusd (asusctl)

description.p: ASUS Control is a lightweight control panel for ASUS laptops on Linux, in the spirit of G-Helper on Windows. It talks to asusd (asusctl) over D-Bus to manage fan curves, performance profiles, keyboard lighting and GPU modes, and reads temperatures, fan speeds and battery state straight from sysfs.
